rule: Raw Zoho status values are stored VERBATIM and NEVER overwritten, in external_status_raw, alongside the product and API version that produced them. This registry maps them to a C3 business status. An UNMAPPED raw value never guesses: the record is accepted, the raw value preserved, and a reconciliation_exception of kind UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS is raised. Same fail-closed philosophy as domain.lifecycle_permits.
product_separation_rule: Every mapping row names its product. A Books mapping is NOT evidence for an ERP mapping and must never be applied to one. The adapter selects the mapping set by integration_connection.product.
target_registry: C3_statuses.json - every maps_to value in this file must exist there. Enforced by a contract test.
provisional_note: ERP rows are marked provisional pending client decision D-14. Zoho ERP v3 is the provisional target; the client may be running Books + Inventory. Both mapping sets are maintained to the same standard.

mappings.verification_required: Enumerate the actual status values present in the tenant during Phase 0B-2. Zoho does not publish an exhaustive enum for purchase order status; these rows are derived from the documented status-transition endpoints and MUST be confirmed against live data.
Same caveat as ERP. Documented transitions are /status/open, /status/billed, /status/cancelled, /submit, /approve, /reject.

rows.note: operational only - a draft receive has no business-status consequence
operational only - shown as an integration badge, not a business status
drives the received_paise ledger component, not a document business status

mappings.note: received_status intentionally maps to no C3 business status. Receipt state affects the LEDGER (received, received_not_billed), not a document lifecycle label. Mapping it to a business status would misrepresent it.

mappings.verification_required: MUST be enumerated in Phase 0B-2. Zoho ERP Purchase Receives has only four endpoints and NO list endpoint, so status values cannot be surveyed by enumeration. They must be observed through PO-anchored detail reads.

mappings.note: Bill status drives accounting_status, NOT a C3 business status. accounting_status in {Approved, Reversal} is the accounting-effective set - preserved exactly from AUD-C-004. Payment state (paid, partially_paid, overdue) is out of scope: this system does not process payments.

unmapped_handling.action: accept the record, preserve external_status_raw verbatim, raise reconciliation_exception kind UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS
unmapped_handling.never: guess a mapping, drop the record, or default to a business status
unmapped_handling.blocks: period close, and capitalisation, while OPEN

registry_rules: Every mapping is data, versioned and effective-dated - never a hardcoded dict in application code.
Every maps_to value must exist in C3_statuses.json. Enforced by tests/test_contracts.py.
A null maps_to is a deliberate assertion that the raw value has no business-status meaning, not an omission. Nulls are reviewed, not defaulted.
Rows marked verification_required cannot be relied upon until Phase 0B-2 confirms them against the tenant.
